headline: EMBER RIDER rolls out — PINBALL gets a row of cabinets
lede: Cabinet select is real now: the attract screen stands two live machines, and CABINET TWO "EMBER RIDER" plays a mirrored table with a hotter economy. The build grew BALL SEARCH on the way — a stalled ball drains itself after 20 world-seconds, so no seed can wedge a game open. pinballcheck 139/139, 26/26 live legs in Chrome.

notes.text: PROOF PATTERN: a mirror cabinet is provable, not tunable — mirrored inputs replay cabinet one to 1e-9 px with identical event inventories; an ember-curl mutant fails 3 checks.
Wall-clock budgets lie in browser suites under load: fixed ffToOver waits missed game-overs; poll + re-feed the actuator instead of ever raising a physics bar.
Rebase conflict rescue: rebuild the contested file from the ORIGINAL sha with git merge-file against the upstream commit — never from memory. Trust only the tree the gates saw.
